story.headline: Unified Healthcare Data. Intelligent Outcomes.
story.subheadline: A modern Databricks-centric data ecosystem that converts fragmented clinical, operational, financial, streaming, and unstructured data into trusted intelligence and workflow action.
story.thesis: The platform is not the destination. It is the governed foundation that lets Parkview move from fragmented data to rapid insights, predictive intelligence, and AI-enabled workflows.

foundationComponents.title: Core Application System Data
foundationComponents.summary: Ingest, normalize, and cross-aggregate data from the systems that run the health system so teams can analyze activity across departments, service lines, and legal entities.
benefits: Creates a shared source of truth for key metrics
Reduces data silos and duplicate reporting effort

foundationComponents.title: Streaming Data
foundationComponents.summary: Enable near-real-time feeds from integration engines, event streams, and connected devices so operational teams can respond to time-sensitive signals.
benefits: Acts as a connection hub to relevant user systems
Enables proactive action on time-sensitive triggers
Improves visibility into lagging or summary metrics

foundationComponents.title: Unstructured Data
foundationComponents.summary: Convert files, images, faxes, transcripts, and machine-generated documents into searchable, analyzable, AI-ready data products.
benefits: Makes hidden context available to analytics and AI
Enables data enrichment for downstream decisions

platformDataProducts.title: Certified Metrics
platformDataProducts.description: Gold-layer metric definitions with lineage, ownership, and quality checks so executives and operators use the same language.

platformDataProducts.title: Normalized Views
platformDataProducts.description: Reusable consumption-ready views that standardize patient, encounter, provider, claim, supply, and finance concepts.

platformDataProducts.title: Forecast / Budget
platformDataProducts.description: Planning-ready datasets that connect historical performance, run-rate assumptions, and predictive signals.

platformDataProducts.title: Interop
platformDataProducts.description: FHIR, HL7, API, and partner exchange patterns that allow the platform to serve both analytics and operational integration needs.

platformDataProducts.title: Transaction Detail
platformDataProducts.description: Traceable detail-level data for drill-down analysis across encounters, claims, payments, orders, schedules, and supply activity.

platformDataProducts.title: Reusable AI Features
platformDataProducts.description: Curated features, embeddings, and governed model inputs that reduce the lift for future AI and predictive use cases.

analyticsCapabilities.title: Rapid Insights
analyticsCapabilities.description: Self-service analytics and guided executive reporting on trusted data products.

analyticsCapabilities.title: Predictive Analytics
analyticsCapabilities.description: Models that estimate future outcomes and expose leading indicators for earlier intervention.

analyticsCapabilities.title: AI & Workflow
analyticsCapabilities.description: AI-powered interfaces and operational apps that act on governed data in the flow of work.
examples: AI outputs surfaced in clinical workflows

featuredUseCase.title: Post-Acquisition Data Integration Hub
featuredUseCase.description: Integrate acquired-system clinical and financial data into Databricks, map key definitions to an enterprise glossary, and publish certified metrics for analysis in Sigma.
benefitsToValidate: Earlier identification of data quality gaps
Reusable integration pattern for future transactions

dataDomains.name: Clinical Data
dataDomains.summary: Encounters, diagnoses, procedures, orders, medications and results.

dataDomains.name: Operational Data
dataDomains.summary: Scheduling, throughput, capacity, referrals, utilization and staffing.

dataDomains.name: Financial Data
dataDomains.summary: Charges, claims, payments, contract, budget and revenue cycle detail.

dataDomains.name: Master Data
dataDomains.summary: Patient, provider, location, service line, payer and organization dimensions.

dataDomains.name: Documents / Images
dataDomains.summary: Scans, faxes, images, reports, transcripts and generated files.

useCases.name: Post-Acquisition Data Integration Hub
useCases.description: Integrate acquired health-system data and inaccessible financial data into Databricks, standardize key data elements and publish certified metrics for analysis in Sigma.
useCases.timeline: Phased pilot, then reusable acquisition pattern
quantitativeBenefits: Days from data-source access to executive KPI availability
Manual extracts, spreadsheets and duplicate reports retired
Data-quality defects discovered, remediated and monitored
Priority metrics with certified definitions and lineage
qualitativeBenefits: Faster leadership visibility after acquisition close
Consistent definitions across acquired and existing entities
Confidence in financial, operational and regulatory reporting
useCases.demo: Reserve this space for a Sigma dashboard, architecture walk-through or short video that shows acquisition data moving from source systems into certified metrics.

useCases.name: Sigma AI Business Intelligence
useCases.description: Use Sigma on top of governed Databricks data products to give executives and analysts a spreadsheet-familiar BI experience with governed metrics and AI-assisted exploration.
useCases.demo: Demo a finance or operational workbook that drills from a leadership metric into transaction detail.

useCases.name: Redox ADT Integration
useCases.description: Stream admissions, discharges and transfers through Redox into the healthcare data platform to support operational visibility and downstream workflow triggers.
quantitativeBenefits: Coverage of facilities and ADT event types
qualitativeBenefits: Reduced reliance on lagging daily reports
Stronger foundation for command-center use cases
useCases.demo: Show a live-style ADT event moving into the platform and updating a patient-flow queue.

useCases.name: Continuity of Care Document Processing
useCases.description: Extract clinically relevant facts from scanned and faxed continuity-of-care documents and make them searchable, routable and available to analytics and AI workflows.
qualitativeBenefits: Better patient context for downstream tools
useCases.demo: Show a document summary, extracted fields and the downstream queue or search experience.

useCases.name: Clinical Command Center
useCases.description: Combine current operational events, clinical data and forecasts to support enterprise visibility into patient flow, capacity and prioritized interventions.
useCases.demo: Optional future-state visualization with alert tiles, census trends and action queues.

useCases.name: Clinician Scheduling Optimization
useCases.description: Use demand, availability, service line patterns and staffing data to improve schedule alignment and reduce manual planning effort.
useCases.demo: Show scenario planning for clinic capacity and staffing options.

useCases.name: Supply Chain Optimization
useCases.description: Connect clinical demand, inventory, ERP and purchasing data to improve spend visibility, forecast utilization and reduce operational waste.
qualitativeBenefits: Improved coordination across finance, supply chain and operations
useCases.demo: Show spend and utilization dashboard with drill-through to item-level detail.

useCases.name: Patient Engagement Chatbot
useCases.description: Ground patient-facing or team-facing AI assistants in trusted Parkview content, operational data and workflow context.
useCases.timeline: Governed AI pilot after data foundation maturity
qualitativeBenefits: Better handoff to staff when human review is needed
useCases.demo: Show a governed Q&A flow with citations to approved content and escalation guardrails.

narrativePillars.name: Better Patient Outcomes
narrativePillars.copy: Connected, trusted data helps leaders prioritize decisions that improve care.

narrativePillars.name: Operational Efficiency
narrativePillars.copy: Reusable services reduce one-off reporting and speed day-to-day action.

narrativePillars.name: Financial Performance
narrativePillars.copy: Standard metrics and transaction detail improve margin, forecasting and risk visibility.

narrativePillars.name: Compliance and Trust
narrativePillars.copy: Governed definitions, quality rules and lineage improve confidence in reporting.

narrativePillars.name: Innovation at Scale
narrativePillars.copy: A data and AI-ready architecture makes new use cases easier to launch and govern.
